intro: Own1 is a personal AI computer you keep at home or in the office. Nexy is the assistant on it, and now on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too, all connected to your own Own1 over a private network.

facts.label: Nexy Engine: one of the smallest AI agent engines
ways to run Nexy: Own1, Mac, Windows, Android, cloud, Docker
open-source apps one click away on OwnXOS
AI models bundled: Nexy uses the ones you already run

news.title: Your phone, powered by your gaming PC
news.text: A phone with no AI model of its own asked for an image. The Own1 passed the job to a gaming PC's graphics card and returned it in 17 seconds, about five times faster than the Own1 on its own. Every result says which device made it.

news.title: Nexy beta for Mac, Windows and Android
news.text: One download page with a step-by-step install guide. All three apps tell you when an update is ready.

news.title: Add a device with an 8-character code
news.text: Your Own1 shows a short code, you type it into Nexy, and you approve the device on the Own1 itself. Guest codes let family or a team use your Own1 within limits you set.

news.title: Independent security reviews before the beta
news.text: Two reviews of the apps, the web app, the agent engine and the Own1, before opening to testers. The issues found in the apps are fixed.

news.title: A new AI agent engine, built small
news.text: Written in Rust, it is one of the smallest agent engines around: a single 3.5 MB program that leaves the machine's memory to the AI model. Open source.

news.title: Open your Own1 from anywhere
news.text: The apps reach your Own1 over an encrypted network and sign in with a key only you hold. No router changes, no third-party cloud in the middle.

tracks.name: Own1
tracks.summary: A personal AI computer: the AI runs on the box, and your data stays on hardware you own.

Image, music, voice and website studios that run entirely on the box

tracks.name: Own1 private desktop
tracks.summary: A desktop only the owner can open, kept apart from the public demo.
highlights: Signed in with a key only the owner holds
Now opens from the Nexy desktop and Android apps, over the private network
tracks.next: Its own AI service, fully separate from the demo

tracks.name: Nexy
tracks.summary: One assistant for chat, research, projects and routines, the same wherever you run it.
highlights: Runs on Own1, Mac, Android, Nexy Cloud and Docker
Researches the web and cites its sources

tracks.name: Nexy Engine
tracks.summary: The agent behind Nexy: a new engine in Rust, built to stay out of the AI model's way.
highlights: One of the smallest agent engines: a 3.5 MB program
Works with any local AI model server; open source

tracks.name: Nexy for Mac and Windows
tracks.summary: Nexy as a desktop app: on your own computer, in Nexy Cloud, or on your Own1.
highlights: Mac and Windows beta, with automatic updates
Can share its graphics card with your Own1, so your other devices use it
tracks.next: Asking questions about a folder of documents

tracks.name: Nexy for Android and iPhone
tracks.summary: Nexy on your phone, powered by your own Own1 or Nexy Cloud. The phone needs no AI model of its own.
highlights: Android beta: add it to your Own1 with an 8-character code
Images and answers can be made on your own computers, through your Own1

tracks.name: Private network
tracks.summary: An encrypted network joining your devices, where each device's address comes from its own key.
highlights: Built into the Nexy apps, no setup or admin rights needed
Reaches an Own1 about three times faster than going through a public relay
tracks.next: Your devices sharing AI: a phone using your Own1's GPU

tracks.name: Nexy Cloud
tracks.summary: Nexy hosted for you, for anyone without an Own1 yet.
highlights: A private, isolated machine for each user
Answers on a trusted Own1 first, then on its own model
tracks.next: Accounts with passkey sign-in, then GPU credits

facts.label: improvements shipped to Own1 since July
Nexy app releases in 13 days, each tested before release

shipped.title: Every update tested on a brand-new Own1
shipped.benefit: Each change is built and booted on a fresh box before release, so new owners get exactly what was tested.

shipped.title: Leaner AI services, rewritten in Rust
shipped.benefit: Device pairing and the AI gateway now run as small, fast programs, leaving more of the box for the AI models.

shipped.title: Nexy Cloud answers on a trusted Own1
shipped.benefit: Cloud users get answers from a full-size model on an Own1 that has spare capacity, and every reply says where it ran.

shipped.title: One gateway for every AI model
shipped.benefit: A single service starts, shares and watches the box's models, and restarts one that stops responding.

shipped.title: Choose what each device can do
shipped.benefit: The owner sets a device's access when approving it, and can change it at any time.

shipped.title: Chat and images at the same time
shipped.benefit: The box keeps room for the text and image models together, so neither waits for the other.

shipped.title: One Nexy everywhere
shipped.benefit: Own1 runs the same Nexy as the apps and the web, so every improvement reaches every device at once.

shipped.title: A choice of agent engines
shipped.benefit: Owners can run Nexy Engine or one of two other open-source agents, each with its own tools.

shipped.title: Safer device pairing
shipped.benefit: Adding a device needs a recent owner sign-in and a single-use approval on the box.

shipped.title: Owner mode and demo mode, one system
shipped.benefit: The same software runs a private owner box or a public demo, so the demo shows the real product.

shipped.title: Devices page
shipped.benefit: Pair phones and laptops, hand out guest codes, and remove a device in one tap.

shipped.title: Your devices use your Own1's AI
shipped.benefit: Paired laptops and phones run on the box's models, with the owner always first in line.

shipped.title: Publish a page from your box
shipped.benefit: Share puts a saved page online and keeps it there until you unpublish it.

shipped.title: Nexy on Telegram
shipped.benefit: Message your Own1's assistant from Telegram.

shipped.title: Personal demo codes
shipped.benefit: Every visitor gets their own one-time code to try the demo desktop.

shipped.title: Turn a chat into a project
shipped.benefit: A conversation with several steps becomes a project you can come back to.

shipped.title: Take over the agent's browser
shipped.benefit: Watch the agent browse live, and take control yourself whenever you want.

shipped.title: Image jobs wait their turn
shipped.benefit: A queued image waits for the graphics card instead of failing.

shipped.title: AI employees that leave receipts
shipped.benefit: They work in their role, wait for your review and keep working with the tab closed.

shipped.title: Click any part of a page to edit it
shipped.benefit: Point at a heading or a footer and say what to change.

shipped.title: Every NixOS package, 365 self-hosted apps
shipped.benefit: Browse, ask Nexy about an app, and open it with one link.

shipped.title: Routines that run around the clock
shipped.benefit: A new routine runs straight away, then on its schedule.

shipped.title: Report a problem, kept on your box
shipped.benefit: Feedback is saved on the owner's own hardware, not sent away.

shipped.title: One-command test suite
shipped.benefit: Every change is checked by an automated suite that writes a readable report.

shipped.title: Nexy becomes the Own1 assistant
shipped.benefit: One always-on assistant across the whole desktop.

shipped.title: Edit the open page in place
shipped.benefit: Changes apply to the page you are looking at instead of rebuilding it.

shipped.title: Four conversations at once
shipped.benefit: The text model now serves four requests at the same time.

shipped.title: Sites fix their own broken images
shipped.benefit: A build repairs missing images and clipped labels instead of failing.

inReview.title: One address and one sign-in for the whole box
inReview.benefit: Every app on an Own1 opens from a single address after a single sign-in.

inReview.title: Agents ready on the very first boot
inReview.benefit: A brand-new box has its assistant working the first time it starts.

upcoming.benefit: Sign in with your phone's or laptop's passkey; no password to remember.

upcoming.benefit: Buy credits for faster cloud GPUs when you need them; free use stays free.
